description: context-toolkit hooks: rtk bash-output filter, code-review-graph incremental graph updates, caveman-ultra reminder. All guarded so a machine missing a dependency degrades to a no-op instead of failing the tool call.

hooks.command: if command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1; then rtk hook claude; else cat; fi

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true

command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'code-review-graph: no graph yet for this repo. Run: code-review-graph build --repo <repo-root>'

echo 'context-toolkit: caveman skill should stay active at ultra intensity by default for this session (unless the user said "stop caveman" / "normal mode"). If not yet activated this session, invoke it before responding.'
